name: item
title: Review item
description: A node on the board. Numbered nodes are items: they show the review buttons their kind offers and reflect the person's response.

attributes.data-kind: question | finding | decision | risk | action | topic | note
attributes.data-status: open | acknowledged | dropped | commented | context | later
attributes.data-pinned: present when the person moved it

whenToUse: Anything the agent draws that the person should read or respond to.
whenNotToUse: Region headings and lane labels; those belong to the region pattern.
accessibility: Focusable group with a label naming number, kind, title and status. Buttons are real buttons with labels and aria-pressed. Keyboard: A X C M L O respond, Alt+Arrows move, R resets the position, J K move between items.
